messages:
Marta - Procurement: FYI we received a renewal from VectorBay for embedding infra. Two proposals: committed capacity vs purely metered. Putting here for quick triage. Link to proposal: https://drive.google.com/vectorbay-renewal. @Alex @Sanjay @Priya @Ting

Alex (Finance): Please paste the pricing lines. We need to compare committed vs metered TCO over a 12-month horizon. Include payment terms and any minimums.

Marta - Procurement: Copying the quote snippet:

```
Committed Plan:
  6 reserved nodes @ $1,200/mo = $7,200/mo
  Included throughput: 300M embeddings/month (pooled)
  Overage: $0.000015/embed
  Billing: monthly, NET30
Metered Plan:
  $0.000025/embed
  Quarterly volume discounts: 10% >750M/qtr, 18% >1.5B/qtr
  Billing: monthly, NET30
Term: 12 months
Support: Standard (upgrade for SLA)
```

Sanjay (ML Eng): Our current run is ~90M embeddings/mo (~1.08B/yr). Metered: ~1.08B * 0.000025 = $27,000/yr (before discounts). Committed: $86,400/yr but includes a big pool. If we grow, committed could be cheaper.

Ting Li (Platform): Questions for vendor: is the "embedding" meter per-call or per-dimension? How do they treat batched calls and partial failures? Do reserved nodes guarantee latency SLOs? We need billing line-level granularity for teams.

Priya (Legal): Need termination clauses, data export SLA, and liability cap for outages. Also ask for a change-of-control clause and confidentiality exceptions for shared embeddings.

VectorBay Rep: Hi all 44b Thanks for sharing. Metering is per-embedding call regardless of vector dimension. Batched calls are counted by number of embedding vectors processed. Reserved nodes include a performance SLA (99.5% uptime) and org-pooled capacity. We can offer a hybrid: 2 reserved nodes + usage overlay at $0.000017/embed and a 10% discount on overlay if you commit to 12 months. We can provide sample invoices and a metering spec.

Alex (Finance): Hybrid option sounds promising. Please send a sample invoice that shows line items for reserved vs usage in a high-peak month, and a modeled annual cost with and without growth assumptions. Also propose a cap on price increases year-over-year.

Sanjay (ML Eng): Engineering would like p95 latency numbers for embedding endpoint at our expected load and at 2x. Our p95 target is <60ms. If reserved nodes don't meet this, lower price or credits expected. Also please confirm whether dimensionality affects inference time billing (you said meter is per-call but compute cost varies).

VectorBay Rep: We will deliver: (1) revised quote with hybrid pricing, (2) sample peak invoice, (3) metering spec, and (4) SLA appendix including latency and credit mechanics. Expect docs within 48 hours.

Marta - Procurement: Thanks. @Procurement-Bot please open a PR when those docs land and include approvers: Alex, Priya, Security.

Procurement-Bot: PR #490 created: "VectorBay renewal review". Approvers requested: Alex (Finance), Priya (Legal), Security. Link: https://procurement.internal/pr/490

Marta - Procurement: Also ask VectorBay to confirm data residency options (we require us-west or eu-west for different teams) and details on audit logs for billing traces.

VectorBay Rep: Confirmed: us-west and eu-west residency available. Audit logs are available on the enterprise plan and can be exported daily. Will include this in the revised package.

Marta - Procurement: Great. Will reconvene after we receive the package. :thumbsup:
